about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Third Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech You, O Lord: may the sacraments we have received both restore us with spiritual nourishment and protect us with bodily help. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: may restore us with spiritual nourishment
may protect us with bodily aid
who lives and reigns with You
